methods.label: Check all four relations
methods.explanation: ① Each value of $x$ corresponds to a unique value of $y$, so it is a function. ② When $x>0$, it corresponds to two values of $y$, so it is not a function. ③ When $x\ne0$, $y$ is unique, so it is a function. ④ When $x=1$, $y=\pm\sqrt{3}$, so it is not a function. Therefore, only ① and ③ are functions, giving 2 in total.
